title: Withdrawals
purpose: See every recorded withdrawal of consent and which still need follow-up.
summary: Every recorded withdrawal of consent, and which still need follow-up.

tasks.title: Find withdrawals needing follow-up
steps: Open [[More filters]], choose Needs follow-up and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Record a withdrawal
steps: Open the consent and select Withdraw consent there.

good_to_know: Needs follow-up means specimens without its hold, or a shipment without a recorded follow-up.
Held, Allocations released and Distributed are counts from when it was recorded.
Withdrawals are recorded on consent pages, so this tab has no New button.

sections.title: Tabs
paragraphs: Consents lists the consents; Withdrawals lists the withdrawals. Withdrawals are recorded from the consent page, so this tab has no New button.

items.label: Consent
items.description: Participant and study; opens the consent at its withdrawals.

items.label: State
items.description: In effect (use stopped), Do not contact (contact only) or Reinstated.

items.label: Effective withdrawal
items.description: No further contact, No further use, or No further use and destroy. For an escalated withdrawal the row shows the destruction instruction followed by the original kind.

items.label: Original effective, Original received
items.description: The original withdrawal's effective date and when it reached the repository. Open the consent for the escalation dates.

items.label: Held (specimens), Allocations released (count), Distributed (specimens)
items.description: What the withdrawal did when it was recorded.

items.label: Recorded by
items.description: Who recorded the original withdrawal and any escalation.

items.label: Effective withdrawal, Study, State
items.description: Filters, initially all. Choose No further use and destroy to include escalated withdrawals.

items.label: More filters: Needs follow-up
items.description: In effect and stopping use, with specimens in custody that have no hold from it, or with a shipment of the participant's material without a recorded follow-up. The dashboard's withdrawals queue opens this filter.

items.label: Search, filters, Apply, Clear all
items.description: Search and the filters narrow the rows on the server; Apply runs them and Clear all removes every filter and the search. Active filters show as chips you can remove one by one. An invalid filter shows an error and no rows rather than everything.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Shows or hides columns for you; the first column stays.

items.label: Sorting and paging
items.description: Click a sortable heading to sort; click again to reverse. Rows per page: 25, 50 or 100. The count under the table is the number of rows matching the filters.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads rows matching the current filters and sort as UTF-8 CSV, up to 10,000 rows. Narrow the filters for a larger selection. The Withdrawal column keeps the original kind. Effective withdrawal shows the current instruction. Escalated entries include the escalation's effective date, receipt time and channel, recording time, recorder and reason. Cells a spreadsheet would read as a formula get a leading apostrophe. The audit records who exported the selection and how many rows.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.
